cast.vocalist: Wiry olive-skinned frontman, dense halo of black corkscrew curls, burgundy sleeveless tank exposing bare shoulders; black handheld wired microphone with a small round silver grille. At downstage centre.
cast.guitarist: Black woman with a close buzz cut, faded mustard work shirt open over a black tank, battered cream solid-body electric guitar with black pickguard. At audience left.
cast.bassist: Broad-shouldered pale man with long copper hair, navy mechanic coveralls, black four-string bass on a canvas strap. At audience right.
cast.drummer: Muscular brown-skinned man with shaved head, white sleeveless tee, large oxblood acoustic drum kit and brass cymbals on the centre rear riser.
cast.stage: Enormous open-air festival in a dusty field, scaffold towers, black stage drape, four musicians on stage, amber PAR cans, audience stretching to the tree line.
cast.crowd: Dense sea of young adult festival fans in faded cotton shirts behind a steel crush barrier, long-haired fans, fists in air, late afternoon dust over distant trees.

look: Candid late-1990s live concert documentary footage. Breezy outdoor festival, warm amber sidelight, weathered black stage drape, sweaty skin, deep shadows, dusty 35mm film, natural motion blur, photorealistic.
